shared_benchmark_traits.timing_scope: GPU generate+55sortstages+reconstruct pipeline only; 57 ordered launches per operation. Original native host allocation/transfer/string wrapper excluded consistently.
keyconfounds: Named1021-byte DNA case and1024-entry padded sorttable, not the source million-byte default.
Native main implicit std::string construction excludes terminal NUL; study therefore sorts cyclic rotations without an included sentinel. Do not call the table a general sentinel-based suffix array.
57 host-issued GPU launches per operation; performance includes host orchestration. No FLOP roofline claim for this integer/string workload.
Original native end-to-end bwt() allocation/transfer/string lifecycle is outside the GPU-only measurement contract.
Large retained host-clock timing variation in cuda_jl: all four samples retained in required mean; cause unmeasured, do not interpret inflated mean as stable device-kernel cost.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute the last column of lexicographically sorted cyclic rotations of a DNA-symbol sequence.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Burrows-Wheeler cyclic rotation ordering, bitonic network sorting of rotation indices, and predecessor-symbol reconstruction.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Discrete linear DNA string with cyclic comparison topology and power-of-two padded index table.
invariants: Valid rotation indices form a permutation0..N-1, followed by negative padding.
Complete cyclic-rotation ordering is checked independently.
accuracy_requirements: Exact all1021 transform bytes and1024 table entries against both GPU references and independent CPU materialized-rotation lexical sort.
Unique rotations are asserted for the fixture, avoiding undefined tie-order comparisons.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: No floating arithmetic; byte ordering, modulo indices, negative padding and stage dependencies determine correctness.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: N1021, padded1024, three internal repeats; no default million-size scaling result.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Native main explicitly identifies ATCG as a bioinformatics alphabet. This is a transform/indexing primitive, not an end-to-end read aligner or compression pipeline.

scientific_intent.uncertainty: No real genome, biological downstream accuracy metric, sentinel-based inversion workflow or large-scale application dataset is measured.
